What is This Part?
This is the Cool Air Hose for the Suzuki Samurai 1.3L / 8 valve engine.
Superior Heat Resistant Foil Shell Exterior
Includes Rubber Joint to connect to Air breather Intake!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cool Air Hose
Qty 1 – Joint for Air Intake
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
